StaffMember.title: StaffMember
StaffMember.description: A laboratory employee registered by the lab manager.

userId.description: Authenticated lab manager UID owning this record.

name.description: Full name of the laboratory staff member.

isActive.description: Whether the employee is currently active in the lab.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

AttendanceRecord.title: AttendanceRecord
AttendanceRecord.description: Daily check-in and check-out attendance entry stamped with authoritative global network UTC time.

userId.description: Authenticated lab manager UID owning this attendance log.

workDateUtc.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format from global network time.

checkInUtcIso.description: ISO-8601 UTC check-in timestamp from global time server.

checkInDisplayTime.description: Formatted check-in time for display and WhatsApp message.

checkInEpochMs.description: Epoch milliseconds in UTC from global time server.

checkOutUtcIso.description: ISO-8601 UTC check-out timestamp from global time server, or empty before checkout.

checkOutDisplayTime.description: Formatted check-out time, or empty before checkout.

checkOutEpochMs.description: Epoch milliseconds in UTC for check-out, or 0 before checkout.

checkOutSource.description: Authoritative global time source for check-out, or empty before checkout.

whatsappSent.description: Whether the instant WhatsApp notification was triggered.

notes.description: Optional note for the attendance shift.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/staff/{staffId}.description: Laboratory employees owned by the authenticated manager.

/users/{userId}/attendance/{recordId}.description: Attendance check-in and check-out logs stamped via global network time.
